observations: Three photos show a black rectangular console with two controllers and two coiled cables on top, placed on a transparent plastic sheet.
The console has a visible PlayStation logo on the top left corner (photo 0, 1, 2).
One controller is white with a custom skin featuring colorful graphics; the other is black and appears standard.
Two black cables are tied with yellow zip ties — one appears to be a power cable, the other possibly an HDMI or USB cable.
The console surface shows some scratches and wear, especially on the left side.
No disc drive is visible on the front of the console — it appears to be a slim or Pro model.
No games, manuals, or original packaging are visible in any photo.
Watermark 'KINGSPEAK GAMING GADGETS' is present across all photos.
No model number, serial number, or branding other than the PlayStation logo is visible.

claims.claim: All versions of PS4 Consoles available in good condition
claims.evidence: Photos show only one console, and no model identifier is visible. 'Good condition' is subjective and not verifiable from photos alone.
Only 2 controllers are visible in the photos. No games are visible in any photo. The claim of 10 games is not supported by visual evidence.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have hardware issues (e.g., disc drive failure, overheating, power issues)
risks.proof: Video showing the console powering on, booting up, and playing a game, or a photo of the model number and serial number.

risks.risk: Console may be a counterfeit or non-genuine unit
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the model number and serial number, or a photo of the console's back panel showing official branding and regulatory labels.

risks.risk: Controllers may be damaged or non-functional (especially the custom-skinned one)
risks.proof: Video showing both controllers connecting to the console and responding to inputs.
risks.if_unproven: priced as one or both controllers may not work

risks.risk: No games included despite seller's claim
risks.proof: Photo showing 10 physical game cases or digital codes, or a video of games being played.

proof_requests: Photo of the console's back panel showing model number and serial number.
Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Photo or video showing 10 games included (physical or digital proof).
Video showing both controllers working with the console.
response.reason: The console's model cannot be identified from the photos, and key claims (10 games, good condition) are not supported. Hidden risks include non-functionality, counterfeit status, and missing accessories. Proof is needed to determine the true value.
